purpose: Rehearse the audited R1 vertical slice under deterministic fake-worker failure scenarios before any runtime activation decision.
bounded_scenarios: duplicate candidate delivery converges to one task
worker A checkpoints then disappears; worker B takes over after lease expiry
superseded worker A cannot checkpoint, consume retry budget, dead-letter, or commit
worker B commits; simulated lost ACK plus process restart converges to the same durable receipt
changed source-document hash makes the older task stale and unable to commit
stale canonical identity fails before task mutation
safe mode denies governed write without staging a candidate
current valid worker can exhaust finite retry budget and task becomes dead-lettered
success_invariants: old worker cannot mutate post-takeover task state
checkpoint survives takeover and can advance only under current lease
same-payload retry after process restart returns the same durable receipt
old task cannot commit after source-document version drift
stale canonical identity and safe mode fail closed
dead-letter is explicit rather than silent success
Owner Exception View is not used as approval authority
claim_boundary: This rehearsal is deterministic local fake-worker evidence only. It is not production runtime evidence, not a live canary, and not evidence of provider/source admissibility or scientific edge.
